segments.title: Pirate Shooting Gallery Grind
segments.notes: Case Blackwell attempts a perfect run on the Resident Evil 4 pirate shooting gallery challenge for over an hour, cycling through repeated failures and strategy adjustments.

segments.title: Castle & Sewer Progression
segments.notes: Blackwell advances through the castle and sewer chapters, managing inventory, upgrading the combat knife, and navigating blue medallion side quests.

segments.title: Kendelle Seattle Check-In
segments.notes: Kendelle calls in live from a citizenM hotel in Seattle, describing the millennial-targeted room design and confirming she is safe while traveling.

segments.title: Krauser Duel & Chapter Close
segments.notes: Extended knife-and-gun battle against Krauser across multiple Leon clones; Blackwell secures the fighting knife drop and reaches a narrative turning point.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid
segments.notes: Blackwell confirms return for news broadcast tomorrow, mentions boyfriend-point maintenance with Kendelle, and executes a raid handoff.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a three-hour solo Resident Evil 4 broadcast, clears the pirate shooting gallery and defeats Krauser after extensive clone cycling.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Calls in from a Seattle citizenM hotel to describe the room layout and confirm travel safety during the Krauser fight intermission.

lore_notes.fact: Blackwell describes himself as 'essentially homeless because I just am constantly running around the world killing people' while in-character as Leon Kennedy.
Kendelle is staying at a citizenM hotel in Seattle where 'every room is a corner room' with projecting window bays.
Blackwell references 'max my boyfriend points' regarding Kendelle during sign-off.

episode_summary: Lead anchor Case Blackwell devotes a full broadcast to a Resident Evil 4 marathon, spending the first hour grinding a pirate shooting gallery for a perfect score before pushing through the castle and sewer chapters. After an extended multi-clone knife duel with Krauser yields the fighting knife, Kendelle checks in from a Seattle hotel, and Blackwell signs off confirming a return to news duties the following afternoon.
